spec.problem: The learner Quiz screen receives incompatible template DTOs and invokes unregistered session/official-availability routes; the real practice journey does not reach question/result state.

acceptance.text: Anonymous /:locale/quiz follows the real localized login gate and leaks no private sessions.
Authenticated templates render localized titles and actual section counts from GET /api/quiz/templates; no card displays zero due to a field-name mismatch.
Through visible UI, a learner starts a published practice template, answers a question, advances/completes, and sees persisted result/feedback.
Active session, history, question and result endpoints enforce current learner identity and return documented contracts without 404s.
Official availability is read from the feature flag and server entitlement state; official question content stays protected.
390x844 and desktop Quiz layouts have no horizontal overflow, and BJT guide text meets readable light/dark contrast.
When a session has no calibrated estimated score, the result view displays an unavailable placeholder instead of 0/800.
An active timed session uses a focused mobile layout without learner chrome or promotional content and has no horizontal overflow at 390x844.
If the server expires a timed answer with 409 session expired, the learner automatically loads the persisted completed result; unrelated 409 conflicts retain the error state.

The paid official simulation availability and start gate recognize the canonical quiz.official_simulation entitlement from an active subscription; the feature flag remains a separate server-side gate.

Quiz completion records its associated bjt_quiz daily-study-plan progress atomically in the canonical persisted gamification schema; the updated task remains visible after a subsequent read, and the independent progress endpoint continues to work.
The authenticated homepage StudyGoalWidget renders the normalized study-plan response accurately, including target minutes, aggregate progress, and per-task completion.
An expired timed session is finalized and its daily quiz progress is recorded exactly once when active-session recovery runs.
Question and answer endpoints reject abandoned sessions and recheck official feature and entitlement access before serving or mutating a session.
Study-goal API distinguishes the default from persisted settings, and the learner sees goal choices until one is saved.
Reading Assist loads the learner deck list from the canonical /api/flashcards/decks endpoint without an unexplained 404.
Completed official quiz breakdowns recheck the server feature flag and subscription entitlement before returning prompts or explanations.

spec.expected_behavior: The visible localized quiz hub renders canonical localized template metadata with readable BJT guidance; server-authenticated learner practice supports start, question, answer, resume, result and history using persisted assessment records, while official availability is server-authoritative and unavailable integrations do not produce unexplained 404s.
spec.observed_behavior: Visible /vi/quiz returns 200 for templates but cards show no titles and 0 sections; official status, session history and active-session calls return 404, and no question/result handlers are registered.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only the AUDIT-091 Quiz UI, API handler/test changes, and screen/API audit evidence; do not alter authored question content or learner data.

red_exception.reason: Timer regression is in the newly added Go quiz-session handler, which is absent from the task base; use the policy-required sensitivity mutation instead of treating the base compile failure as RED.
